additional_info.subject: 0447063 - ID0447063-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S4 170003463] No successful charging session on DC2 CRM:00314000229
additional_info.body:
Good evening Furkan,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0447063
for charger
rpfuw1
. The ticket has been opened for issues to charge on DC2.
Today I performed some logs analysis on SCB and AWS, and these are my findings:
I checked on AWS and collected some timestamps of failed sessions at P03_CableCheck from 2025-09-01 and 2025-08-31
From AWS, it seems that the charger was never able to have a successful charging session since 1 month (date of dispenser's commissioning).
The charger is running on v4.0.11, and unfortunately I believe the Hawkbit.conf file is not in the config files, hence I cannot access the charger via SSH.
From the logs, unfortunately I cannot tell which could be the issue. v4.0.11 is a quite old version, and many useful logs are not reported as they were introduced with subsequent FW versions.
From a first analysis and suspicion, the issue could be:
In the EcoG KF11
In the Voltage transducer TF2
In the DC contactor QA13-14 (unlikely).
Unfortunately, without SSH I cannot check if the EcoG has some clear error, and I cannot even check the EcoG logs. Moreover, due to unavailability of colleagues being able to restore the Hawkbit.conf file and provide me SSH, I will only be able to access it by the end of this current week CW36.
Once I will get the access, it would be also necessary to update the charger to v8.0.5 via OTA, as so far it was not possible from your side I believe.
If it is okay for you, we can align again by the end of this week and proceed with the FW updates and further troubleshooting.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!

additional_info.subject: RE: 0447063 - ID0447063-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S4 170003463] No successful charging session on DC2 CRM:00314000229
additional_info.body:
Hello colleagues,
I am following up my last email in regards of ticket
ID0447063.
As per my previous analysis, charger was never able to perform a charging session on DC2, always failing at P03_CableCheck.
I got finally SSH access (as now the charger is on v5.0.23) and analyzed some more logs. These are my findings:
I checked remotely EcoG KF11 and there is no visible error on it.
I checked some failed sessions, DC2 starts the CableCheck and there is no Abnormal feedback on the QA13-14:
Session fails due to CableCheck timeout.
What I see, is that in the logs it is stated that "Cablechek testvoltage is reached"
This reading comes from the power converters, which state that the power converters reached the Cablecheck voltage
However, from SCB logs and EcoG logs, I do not see the voltage building up:
As a conclusion, I believe the issue could be:
TF2 voltage transducer not working fine
The voltage Clamps of TF2 (WC26 and WC27) are defective or not well attached to the copper bars
QA13-14 is not actually closing , even if the feedback is received.
If you are planning to go onsite, please check the above components to troubleshoot the issue.
Please let me know in advance if you need support for when you will be onsite. Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon!
